media.title: Sixers film study: Will Ariel Hukporti stabilize the backup center position?
media.description: Once again, the Sixers appear set to enter a season with a crop of unproven backup centers. Can Ariel Hukporti earn a regular role?

items.title: Ariel Hukporti referenced the Sixers' mix of veterans and young players as a reason he wanted to be here. Mentioned how much he can learn from Joel Embiid. Said his time with the Knicks taught him the value of not giving up.
items.author: Paul Hudrick
items.body_excerpt: Ariel Hukporti referenced the Sixers' mix of veterans and young players as a reason he wanted to be here. Mentioned how much he can learn from Joel Embiid. Said his time with the Knicks taught him the value of not giving up.

items.title: Ariel Hukporti is excited to learn from Joel Embiid and apply some of the lessons he is taking from his tenure with the New York Knicks as he joins the Sixers. He thinks he can help a lot defensively. He did not know about the Jaylen Brown trade when he signed.
